description: Na₅ReO₆ is High Pressure (4-7GPa) Tellurium-derived structured and crystallizes in the monoclinic C2/m space group. There are three inequivalent Na¹⁺ sites. In the first Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form distorted NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra, edges with three equivalent ReO₆ octahedra, and edges with nine NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 18-20°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.30-2.35 Å. In the second Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ReO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ReO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 1-20°. There are a spread of Na-O bond distances ranging from 2.31-2.57 Å. In the third Na¹⁺ site, Na¹⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form NaO₆ octahedra that share corners with two equivalent ReO₆ octahedra, corners with four equivalent NaO₆ octahedra, edges with two equivalent ReO₆ octahedra, and edges with ten NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-18°. There are four shorter (2.27 Å) and two longer (2.71 Å) Na-O bond lengths. Re⁷⁺ is bonded to six O²⁻ atoms to form ReO₆ octahedra that share corners with six NaO₆ octahedra and edges with twelve NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-1°. There are two shorter (1.89 Å) and four longer (1.91 Å) Re-O bond lengths. There are two inequivalent O²⁻ sites. In the first O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded in a 6-coordinate geometry to five Na¹⁺ and one Re⁷⁺ atom. In the second O²⁻ site, O²⁻ is bonded to five Na¹⁺ and one Re⁷⁺ atom to form a mixture of distorted corner and edge-sharing ONa₅Re octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles range from 0-16°.
